screening_decisions.reason: Not a randomized controlled trial; it is a cross-sectional PET imaging study examining receptor binding profiles.
Randomized double-blind trial comparing amisulpride to flupentixol (typical antipsychotic) in patients with acute schizophrenia.
Randomized double-blind trial comparing amisulpride to fluphenazine (typical antipsychotic) in patients with negative schizophrenia.
Describes the development of a rating scale (BPRS); not a clinical trial involving amisulpride.
Cochrane review comparing clozapine to typical antipsychotics; does not involve amisulpride.
Narrative review of pharmacodynamic and pharmacokinetic properties; not a primary randomized controlled trial.
Randomized double-blind dose-ranging study comparing amisulpride to haloperidol (typical antipsychotic) in acute schizophrenia.
Describes the development of a depression rating scale; not a clinical trial involving amisulpride or schizophrenia.
Pharmacokinetic/PET study examining D2 receptor occupancy; not a randomized controlled trial comparing treatments.
Compares neuroendocrine profiles of two new drugs to amisulpride; not an RCT evaluating amisulpride efficacy against placebo or antipsychotics.
Retrospective medico-economic assessment using chart reviews; not a randomized controlled trial.
Randomized double-blind placebo-controlled trial evaluating amisulpride for negative symptoms of schizophrenia.
Randomized double-blind trial comparing amisulpride to haloperidol (typical antipsychotic) in acute exacerbations of schizophrenia.
Randomized double-blind placebo-controlled trial evaluating low-dose amisulpride for primary negative symptoms of schizophrenia.
Population consists of non-psychotic subjects; does not meet the criteria for schizophrenia or serious mental illness.
Describes the development of a nursing observation scale; not a clinical trial involving amisulpride.
Review/commentary article discussing treatment strategies; not a primary randomized controlled trial.
Randomized trial comparing amisulpride to haloperidol (typical antipsychotic) in chronic schizophrenia with persistent negative symptoms.
Describes the development and validation of the PANSS rating scale; not a clinical trial involving amisulpride.
Randomized double-blind trial comparing amisulpride to haloperidol (typical antipsychotic) in schizophrenic patients.
Review article discussing the mechanism of action and clinical profile of amisulpride; not a primary RCT.
Describes a rating scale for drug-induced akathisia; not a clinical trial involving amisulpride.
Randomized double-blind multicentre trial comparing amisulpride to haloperidol (typical antipsychotic) in schizophrenia.
Describes a standardized psychiatric assessment scale; not a clinical trial involving amisulpride.
Randomized double-blind placebo-controlled trial evaluating amisulpride for negative symptoms of schizophrenia.
Review article on atypical neuroleptics in child/adolescent psychiatry; not a primary RCT.
Population is children with infantile autism (not schizophrenia/serious mental illness); compares amisulpride to bromocriptine (not placebo/antipsychotic).
Open-label augmentation trial comparing amisulpride to fluoxetine (antidepressant) added to haloperidol; does not meet criteria for RCT comparing amisulpride to placebo/antipsychotic.
Study on airway resistance measurement in pediatric respiratory patients; completely unrelated to schizophrenia or amisulpride.
Describes a rating scale for extrapyramidal side effects; not a clinical trial involving amisulpride.
Open clinical study (not randomized); abstract indicates pharmacological screening rather than a comparative RCT.
